text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the monumental
end-of-year race, the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Fans are excited for today's sisterly
showdown. Ever since their last matchup
fell through, we've been waiting to see
Biwa Hayahide
versus Narita Brian!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The stands are packed! This is the race
that no one wants to miss!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What a profound feeling to have finally
made it to this day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've been waiting for this a long
time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've completed my winning equation. Don't
think I'll concede this race
just because
you're my sister.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're always overthinking things. Our
race isn't that complicated.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, true enough. We've been destined
for this since we were kids.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go resolve our little sibling
rivalry?
